inputs: Original deterministic Rust synthesis; no recordings, third-party samples or model-generated audio
generator_sha256_note: sha256 over generator_sources in order: each path, LF, the file with CRLF folded to LF, LF
format: 44100 Hz, mono, signed PCM16 little endian WAV
mastering_note: A file's target_mmax_lufs is the mastering target of its bank. It is below -21 only for a peak-bound v1 family: its frozen synthesis cannot reach -21 LUFS within the limiter bound, so the bank is mastered to the loudest half-LU step all its variants reach.
